MDA uses the 9x14 text-mode character cell. CGA-2y supplies the default
thick CGA 8x8 lettering stretched vertically for an 80-column text-mode
presentation (8x16 displayed cell). No font modifications were made.
The presets reproduce lettering and a chosen foreground/background palette,
not graphics modes, CP437 transport, CRT electronics or a PC terminal program.
